items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest level since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Bitcoin falls to 12-week low as Jensen Huangs exit from Nvidia rattles markets
items.summary: Bitcoin fell as low as $71,200 as Jensen Huang quit Nvidia and MSCI confirmed Strategy's removal, with $750M in crypto positions liquidated.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
items.summary: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.

items.title: Illinois Crypto Tax Draws Unlikely Alliance of DOJ, Banks and DeFi
items.summary: The DOJ, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, SIFMA and a crypto coalition led by a16z, Paradigm and Uniswap filed briefs backing a lawsuit to strike down the states 0.2% levy on digital asset transactions.

items.title: Zcash loses $1,000 as dormant wallets send ZEC coins to exchanges
items.summary: Zcash fell below $1,000 as leveraged traders abandoned bullish positions and selling pressure intensified.
